map.输入或随机给一组字母（如 6 个），工具按字典穷举所有「字母不重复使用」且长度: The tool ships 5 fixed letter sets (LISTEN, TRIANGLE, PAINTER, TEACHER, GARDEN) and a built-in common word list (hundreds of 3-8 letter words). Each round picks one set and filters the word list for words spellable with each letter used at most its given multiplicity; submissions must pass both the letter check and the word-list check. It does not enumerate all English words, so rare or unlisted words are not counted.
map.字母组 LISTEN 可重排出 SILENT、TINSEL、ENLIST、INL: The letter set LISTEN yields built-in words such as LISTEN, SILENT, ENLIST, TINSEL, INLETS, LINES, TILES, LINE, TILE, SITE, LIST, LINT, NEST, SENT, TIE and SIN. Words not in the list or not spellable from the letters (SLIME, EMITS, ISLET) are not counted. The number of valid words depends on the letter set and the word-list coverage, usually a dozen to a few dozen.
map.默认每个给定字母在同一单词里至多使用一次（对应原词字母多重数）；若原词含重复字母: By default each given letter is used at most once per word (matching the letter multiplicity of the source); if the source has repeated letters, reuse within that multiplicity is allowed.

map.有效答案 = 内置常用词库中「能由该组字母拼出」的单词（每个字母按给定重数至多使: Valid answers = words in the built-in common word list that "can be spelled from the given letter set" (each letter used at most up to its given multiplicity, length ≥3); on submit the letter multiplicities are checked first, then whether the word is in the list; score = sum of the letter counts of the matched words; the round is cleared when the number of matches equals all valid words for that letter set. The page ships 5 letter sets (LISTEN, TRIANGLE, PAINTER, TEACHER, GARDEN) and a common word list of several hundred words of 3–8 letters; it does not enumerate subsequences or permutations, and rare or unlisted words do not count.
map.工具内置 5 组字母（LISTEN、TRIANGLE、PAINTER、TEACH: The tool ships 5 letter sets (LISTEN, TRIANGLE, PAINTER, TEACHER, GARDEN) and a common English word list (several hundred common words of 3–8 letters). Each round picks a set at random and filters the list for spellable words under "each letter used at most up to its given multiplicity" as the valid answers; a submitted word must pass both the letter check and the list check. It is not an exhaustive enumeration of English words, so rare and unlisted words do not count.
map.字母组 LISTEN 可拼出内置词库中的 LISTEN、SILENT、ENLIS: The letter set LISTEN can spell LISTEN, SILENT, ENLIST, TINSEL, INLETS, LINES, TILES, LINE, TILE, SITE, LIST, LINT, NEST, SENT, TIE, SIN, etc. from the built-in list; SLIME, EMITS and ISLET are not counted because they are unlisted or do not match the letters. The number of valid words depends on the letter set and the list coverage, usually a dozen to a few dozen.
